title: Godot State Charts
summary: Hierarchical state machines built from nodes: compound, parallel and history states, event and timed transitions with guards, and enter/exit/process signals.
useWhen: A player, enemy, menu or game flow has many modes with nested or parallel sub-states (grounded/airborne, armed/unarmed, pause) or needs delayed and guarded transitions that a flat enum state machine handles badly.
avoidWhen: Two or three states with simple switches; an enum and a match statement in the script are enough.
